gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.toggle: Stays enabled until turned off; its components run every server tick while active.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.toggle_c: Stays enabled until turned off; its components tick on the server. Reactivating starts a %s-tick cooldown.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.passive: Always active while the power is owned; no manual activation.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.active: Triggers the registered effect once when used.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.active_c: Triggers the registered effect once, then starts a %s-tick cooldown.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.charged: Charge-based design. This build exposes it as a template, not a working manual action.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.generic: This entry is registered but has no manual runtime path in this build.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.key: Manual ability: use the catalog or radial while its parent power is owned.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.sneak: Manual ability: sneak and use it while its parent power is owned.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.passive_: Passive ability: applied and maintained automatically while accessible.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.tick: Periodic ability: the server maintains it automatically.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.reactive: Reactive ability: triggered by combat events, never manually.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.suit: Loadout metadata only: equipping grants the listed powers and abilities. No character profile is inferred.
gui.ascendant.catalog.mechanics.pack: Content pack metadata: counts and origins only. Its powers, abilities and suits appear in their own tabs.
gui.ascendant.catalog.req.owned: Owned through unlocked powers or the equipped suit.
gui.ascendant.catalog.req.not_owned: Not owned. Unlock it or equip a suit that grants it.
gui.ascendant.catalog.req.loadout: No ownership gate is inferred from the loadout; equipping is server-validated.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.active_long: Use from the catalog (Enter/click) or press V. The server checks ownership and cooldown.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.super_speed_l: Toggle super-speed from the catalog, radial or Z. While active, WASD drives the speedster mode; [ and ] change the level; Left Alt brakes.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.toggle_long: Toggle from the catalog (Enter/click) or press B. Turning it off still works during cooldown.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.key_long: Select it in the catalog or radial and activate; the server validates access and cooldown.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.sneak_long: Hold sneak while activating; otherwise the server refuses the request.
gui.ascendant.catalog.hint.suit_long: Equip from this catalog. The server records the loadout and grants its powers while equipped.
